summary: The PlacementRequestDetails system is designed to handle various aspects of managing placement requests, including documentation, student information, program and course details, and assessments. It includes several user controls and validation mechanisms to ensure data integrity and appropriate access based on user roles.
purpose: The system manages placement requests, providing functionalities for users to enter, review, and process placement-related data. It includes mechanisms for validation, role-based access control, and user interface elements to facilitate interaction with the data.

workflows.name: Page_Load_Process
steps: Parse query strings for DestID and UserType

business_rules: Placement requests are read-only if ended more than 18 months ago unless user is sysadmin.
Placement requests are restricted based on user role (RC, DC, QESEdit).
validations: Date validations for start and end dates
Ensure reply by date is before start date
calculations: Duration calculation based on number of shifts and shift length
conditions: Check user roles for access rights
system_behavior: Display warnings and errors in panels
Handle tab visibility based on user permissions
dependencies: User controls for specific UI components
exceptions: Redirect to appropriate page if necessary
Handle cases for screen access based on user type
